name: Explorer Run MRU
description: Run dialog (Win+R) recently used commands — tracks every command you've typed
privacyImpact: Reveals commands and programs launched via the Run dialog

name: Explorer Typed Paths
description: File Explorer address bar history — paths you've manually typed or pasted
privacyImpact: Reveals folders and network paths accessed via Explorer address bar

name: Explorer Recent Documents
description: Recent documents MRU list tracked by Windows Explorer
privacyImpact: Reveals recently opened documents and file types

name: Common Open/Save Dialog MRU
description: File open and save dialog recently used locations and filenames
privacyImpact: Reveals files opened or saved via standard Windows file dialogs

name: Common Dialog Last Visited
description: Last visited folders in open/save file dialogs
privacyImpact: Reveals folders recently accessed via file open/save dialogs

name: UserAssist Program Tracking
description: ROT13-encoded program launch counts and timestamps tracked by Explorer
privacyImpact: Tracks every program launched via Explorer — names, counts, and last run times

name: Microsoft Office MRU
description: Recently opened files in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
privacyImpact: Reveals recently opened Office documents with full file paths

name: Windows Media Player Recent Files
description: Recently played media files in Windows Media Player
privacyImpact: Reveals recently played audio and video files

name: Paint Recent Files
description: Recently opened files in Microsoft Paint
privacyImpact: Reveals recently opened image files in Paint

name: WordPad Recent Files
privacyImpact: Reveals recently opened documents in WordPad
